mapper.sql: t.task_id AS taskId, t.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, t.bridge_id AS bridgeId, t.provider_id AS providerId, p.provider_code AS providerCode, t.provider_order_id AS providerOrderId, t.task_status AS taskStatus, t.provider_delivery_status AS providerDeliveryStatus, t.expected_ticket_count AS expectedTicketCount, t.issued_count AS issuedCount, t.failed_count AS failedCount, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.max_retry_count AS maxRetryCount, t.issue_idempotency_key AS issueIdempotencyKey, t.request_sent AS requestSent, t.manual_hold AS manualHold, t.next_attempt_time AS nextAttemptTime, t.last_attempt_time AS lastAttemptTime, t.complete_time AS completeTime, t.provider_delivery_version AS providerDeliveryVersion, t.last_operation AS lastOperation, t.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, t.last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage, t.last_error_retryable AS lastErrorRetryable, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_source_issue_task (order_id, bridge_id, provider_id, provider_order_id, task_status, provider_delivery_status, expected_ticket_count, issued_count, failed_count, retry_count, max_retry_count, issue_idempotency_key, request_sent, manual_hold, next_attempt_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{bridgeId}, #{providerId}, #{providerOrderId}, 'PENDING', 'UNKNOWN', #{expectedCount}, 0, 0, 0, #{maxRetryCount}, #{idempotencyKey}, 0, 0, #{nextAttemptTime}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id=VALUES(order_id)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket_source_issue_task t JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=t.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=t.provider_id WHERE t.order_id=#{orderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ticket_source_issue_task t JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=t.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=t.provider_id WHERE t.order_id=#{orderId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.order_id FROM ticket_source_issue_task t JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge b ON b.bridge_id=t.bridge_id WHERE t.manual_hold=0 AND COALESCE(b.order_model,'') <> 'SINGLE_SKU' AND ( (t.task_status IN ('PENDING','WAIT_PROVIDER','RETRY_WAIT','PARTIAL','FAILED') AND (t.next_attempt_time IS NULL OR t.next_attempt_time <= #{now})) OR (t.task_status='PROCESSING' AND t.last_attempt_time IS NOT NULL AND t.last_attempt_time <= #{processingCutoff}) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.next_attempt_time, t.last_attempt_time, t.create_time), t.task_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.ticket_id AS ticketId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_ticket e2 WHERE e2.order_id=e.order_id AND e2.ticket_id <= e.ticket_id) AS ticketIndex, e.ticket_status AS ticketStatus FROM electronic_ticket e WHERE e.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY e.ticket_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET source_provider_id=#{providerId}, provider_order_id=#{providerOrderId}, provider_ticket_id=#{providerTicketId}, ticket_status='UNUSED', credential_type=#{credentialType}, credential_payload=CASE WHEN #{credentialType}='DYNAMIC_QR' THEN NULL ELSE #{credentialPayload} END, credential_version=#{credentialVersion}, qr_code_value=CASE WHEN #{credentialType} IN ('STATIC_QR','QR_CODE') THEN #{credentialPayload} ELSE NULL END, seat_info=#{seatInfo}, seat_zone=#{seatZone}, seat_row=#{seatRow}, seat_number=#{seatNumber}, entrance_info=#{entranceInfo}, generate_time=COALESCE(generate_time, #{issueTime}), provider_issue_time=#{issueTime}, last_source_sync_time=#{syncTime}, expire_time=COALESCE(expire_time, #{expireTime}), abnormal_reason=NULL, update_time=#{syncTime} WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING','ERROR','UNUSED')

UPDATE electronic_ticket SET source_provider_id=#{providerId}, provider_order_id=#{providerOrderId}, provider_ticket_id=#{providerTicketId}, ticket_status='ERROR', credential_type=NULL, credential_payload=NULL, credential_version=NULL, qr_code_value=NULL, generate_time=NULL, provider_issue_time=NULL, last_source_sync_time=#{syncTime}, abnormal_reason=#{reason}, update_time=#{syncTime} WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING','ERROR')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND ticket_status=#{ticketStatus}
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_order SET ticket_issued_time=COALESCE(ticket_issued_time, #{issueTime}), update_time=#{issueTime} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='WAIT_USE'

UPDATE ticket_source_issue_task SET task_status=#{taskStatus}, provider_delivery_status=#{providerDeliveryStatus}, issued_count=#{issuedCount}, failed_count=#{failedCount}, retry_count=#{retryCount}, next_attempt_time=#{nextAttemptTime}, complete_time=#{completeTime}, provider_delivery_version=#{providerDeliveryVersion}, last_operation=#{lastOperation}, last_error_code=#{lastErrorCode}, last_error_message=#{lastErrorMessage}, last_error_retryable=#{lastErrorRetryable}, request_sent=#{requestSent}, manual_hold=#{manualHold}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE order_id=#{orderId}

UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status='GENERATING', abnormal_reason=NULL, qr_code_value=NULL, credential_type=NULL, credential_payload=NULL, credential_version=NULL, provider_ticket_id=NULL, provider_issue_time=NULL, last_source_sync_time=#{now}, update_time=#{now} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND ticket_status='ERROR'

UPDATE ticket_source_issue_task SET task_status='PENDING', provider_delivery_status='UNKNOWN', retry_count=0, issued_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND ticket_status='UNUSED'), failed_count=0, next_attempt_time=#{nextAttemptTime}, complete_time=NULL, last_error_code=NULL, last_error_message=NULL, last_error_retryable=0, manual_hold=0, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND task_status IN ('FAILED','PARTIAL','MANUAL_REVIEW','RETRY_WAIT')
